SCH 3U Unit 3 Test
*show all work, answer needs correct significant digits and units.
1. Calculate the amount of moles of 356 formula units of tin (II) borate, Sn₃(BO₃)₂(s). 2 marks
2. Calculate the mass of 0.59 mol of glucose, C₆H₁₂O₆(s). 2 marks
3. How many atoms of carbon are in a fuel tank containing 2.0 x 10² mol of propane, C₃H₈(g)? 3 marks
4. The percentage composition of butanoic acid is 54.5% carbon, 9.1% hydrogen and 36.4% oxygen.
The molar mass of the compound is 88.1 g/mol. What is the molecular formula of butanoic acid? 8
marks
5. In excess oxygen, aluminum oxidizes and corrodes to form aluminum oxide. Calculate the amount (in
moles) of aluminum oxide, Al₂O₃(s), that is produced when 10.0 g of aluminum is used. 4 marks
6. If 2.0 g of aqueous hydrogen sulfide reacts with 5.0 g of aqueous sodium hydroxide, what mass of
sodium sulfide will be produced? The other product is water. Write a balanced chemical equation for
the reaction. 10 marks
7. Use the lab data below to determine the percentage yield of the silver chloride, AgCl(s), precipitate in
the reaction. Excess CaCl₂(aq) is added. 6 marks
What was measured Mass
Mass of AgNO₃ 1.48 g
Mass of clean, dry filter paper 1.27 g
Mass of dry precipitate and filter paper 2.36 g
Mass of precipitate
2AgNO₃(aq) + CaCl₂(aq) → 2AgCl(s) + Ca(NO₃)₂(aq)
